seoTitle: Archer Test: Which Character Are You? (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Archer test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Archer, Lana, Malory, Cyril, Cheryl, Pam, Krieger or Ray — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the show-off, the only adult in the room or the total wild card? Answer 12 everyday questions about work, friends and nights out, and find out which Archer character you are.

characters.name: Archer
characters.title: The Show-Off
characters.summary: Cocky, reckless and annoyingly good at what you do. You'd rather wing it than plan it.
description: Like Archer, you back yourself completely. He calls himself the world's most dangerous secret agent, code name Duchess.
You were a star long before the job. Archer was offered a lacrosse scholarship to Johns Hopkins.
Your references are your own. Archer is obsessed with Burt Reynolds and keeps quoting Danger Zone.
characters.flaw: You make everything about you, even when it really isn't.
characters.signature: A cocky one-liner and a plan you made up on the spot.
characters.clashReason: they'd turn every conversation into a story about themselves

characters.name: Lana
characters.title: The Only Adult in the Room
characters.summary: Capable, tough and endlessly exasperated. You hold everything together while everyone else falls apart.
description: Like Lana, you're the one who actually gets the job done. She was the top female agent at ISIS.
You can handle yourself. Lana is an expert in Krav Maga.
You keep going when life gets complicated. Lana raised her daughter, AJ, while still working in the field.
characters.flaw: You end up cleaning up everyone else's mess, then resent them for it.
characters.signature: An eye-roll, a sigh and the problem solved before anyone else notices.
characters.clashReason: they'd roll their eyes at every idea you have

characters.name: Malory
characters.title: The Boss
characters.summary: Ruthless, stylish and always working an angle. You expect the best, and you expect someone else to pay for it.
description: Like Malory, you were born to be in charge. She ran the spy agency ISIS.
You'll do whatever it takes to stay on top. When the agency fell apart, she turned it into a drug cartel to keep it going.
You know when to step back, on your own terms. Malory eventually retired and handed the agency to Archer.
characters.flaw: You treat people as tools, then wonder why they don't like you.
characters.signature: Expensive taste, a cutting remark and someone else's credit card.
characters.clashReason: they'd make you do the work and then take all the credit

characters.name: Cyril
characters.title: The Worrier
characters.summary: Careful, anxious and quietly smarter than people think. You follow the rules, even when nobody else does.
description: Like Cyril, you're good with numbers. He's the agency's comptroller.
You've got more qualifications than anyone gives you credit for. Cyril has a law degree.
You want to be taken seriously, and sometimes you get there. Cyril went on to found the Figgis Detective Agency.
characters.flaw: You worry about everything, then let it out as petty little digs.
characters.signature: A spreadsheet, a nervous laugh and a complaint in writing.
characters.clashReason: they'd want everything signed off, in triplicate

characters.name: Cheryl
characters.title: The Wild Card
characters.summary: Unpredictable, chaotic and never boring. Nobody knows what you'll do next, including you.
description: Like Cheryl, you're full of surprises. She's an heiress to the Tunt railroad fortune, despite working as a secretary.
Your life is gloriously odd. Cheryl keeps a pet ocelot named Babou, and she can't stand him.
You reinvent yourself whenever you feel like it. Cheryl has gone by Carol, Cristal and, as a country singer, Cherlene.
characters.flaw: You get bored fast, and boredom makes you do strange things.
characters.signature: A sudden change of plan and a new name to go with it.
characters.clashReason: they'd turn a quiet evening into total chaos

characters.name: Pam
characters.title: The Tough Cookie
characters.summary: Blunt, funny and much tougher than you look. You say what everyone's thinking, and then some.
description: Like Pam, you know everybody's business. She's the agency's Head of Human Resources.
You're stronger than people expect. Pam grew up on her father's Wisconsin dairy farm, and she's an expert bare-knuckle fighter.
You step up when it counts. Pam delivered Lana's baby.
characters.flaw: You share far too much, far too often.
characters.signature: Juicy gossip and a snack you're not sharing.
characters.clashReason: they'd tell everyone your secrets before lunch

characters.name: Krieger
characters.title: The Mad Scientist
characters.summary: Brilliant, eccentric and always building something. You don't ask whether you should, only whether you can.
description: Like Krieger, you love to tinker. He runs the agency's applied research lab.
You can build almost anything. Krieger made Cheryl a mechanical hand.
Your style is your own. Krieger's vans are airbrushed with Rush album art.
characters.flaw: You get so caught up in your projects that you forget other people exist.
characters.signature: A half-finished gadget that definitely isn't safe yet.
characters.clashReason: they'd test their latest invention on you without asking

characters.name: Ray
characters.title: The Sarcastic Pro
characters.summary: Sharp, capable and very done with everyone. You're good at your job, and you'll tell people so.
description: Like Ray, you're quietly one of the most competent people around. He's an analyst and a field agent.
You hold yourself to a high standard. Ray won an Olympic bronze in giant slalom, and calls it a huge disappointment.
You're a loyal friend underneath the sarcasm. Ray is one of Lana's closest friends.
characters.flaw: You complain so much that people stop noticing when something's really wrong.
characters.signature: A perfectly timed sarcastic remark, followed by doing the job right.
characters.clashReason: they'd make a sarcastic comment about everything you do

questions.text: A group project at work goes badly wrong. You...

options.text: Insist it would have worked if they'd done it your way
Quietly fix it while everyone else argues
Remind everyone you raised this concern, in writing
Make sure someone else gets the blame before anyone asks

questions.text: You hear some juicy gossip about a coworker. You...

options.text: Tell everyone before lunch
Say you saw it coming months ago
Keep it to yourself, and use it later
Don't care, unless it's about you

questions.text: You get an unexpected free afternoon. You...

options.text: Take apart an old gadget, and make it do something it really shouldn't
Do something on a whim that's probably a little dangerous
Book a spa afternoon, and put it on the company card
Lie on the couch with a giant bag of snacks

questions.text: You're handed a huge pile of paperwork. You...

options.text: Hand it to someone else and walk off
Do it carefully, and double-check every number
Get it done fast, complaining the whole time
Lose it. Possibly on purpose

questions.text: Someone insults you in front of other people. You...

options.text: Fire back an insult, then a worse one
Offer to settle it outside
Stew about it, then plan some very petty revenge
Give them a look that ends the conversation

questions.text: A friend needs help moving out of their flat this weekend. You...

options.text: Turn up and carry the sofa on your own
Turn up hours late, then show off by carrying two boxes at once
Get distracted rewiring their old lamp instead of packing
Pay for movers instead, and call that helping

questions.text: You're on a big night out with friends. You...

options.text: Order the priciest thing on the menu, and conveniently forget your wallet
End up somewhere nobody remembers getting to
Make sure everyone gets home safely
Head home early, complaining about the music on the way out

questions.text: You're given a budget for a team event. You...

options.text: Track every penny in a spreadsheet
Spend it all on one big, flashy thing
Spend most of it on food, obviously
Put it toward a homemade project nobody asked for

questions.text: A friend asks for your honest advice. You...

options.text: Give it straight, even if it stings
Tell a long story about your own life instead
Think it over for days, then give a very cautious answer
Make a sarcastic joke, and leave it at that

questions.text: Your best friend asks you to give a speech at their wedding. You...

options.text: Rehearse it twenty times, and still sweat through your shirt
Politely say no, and raise a glass from your seat
Say something wildly inappropriate, and sit down proud
Bring a slideshow full of things only you find interesting

questions.text: You're a spy, and your mission goes completely sideways. You...

options.text: Improvise wildly, and somehow pull it off
Take control, and get everyone out alive
Panic, and hide until it's all over
Honestly start having fun

questions.text: You run a spy agency, and it's running out of money. You...

options.text: Take a shady job that pays well, and ask no questions
Sell one of your inventions. Don't ask which one
Tell the team the truth, and work out a plan together
Start looking for a new job before it sinks
